# Shared QPE first attempt

Informed source design by Codex on 2026-09-28. The repository, previous QPE
draft, fixed-width sources and selected hierarchy profile were available.
The exact model deployment and sampling settings are not recorded. This is
not a controlled model evaluation.

The untouched source was saved and hashed before checking with the baseline
0.1.9 compiler. It intentionally expresses the selected future static-size
interface and library vocabulary. These spellings are desired source pending
the G020-1 extension specification, not currently supported syntax. The first
parse rejection measures the baseline gap, not a claim that later checking
would succeed. Standard helper contracts and their implementations must be
provided before calling this an executable QPE.

Remove duplicate phase2/phase3 and target-width bodies, preserving control
access, increasing bit weights and the returned conditional target owner.
Required oracle: complete QPE Fourier-polynomial instrument on correlated
inputs. A forward-QFT or reversed-result client is a semantic counterexample.
